props.text: in an ideal world, this squeezes one more time to trap some positioning before a healthy pullback.

Market structure observation on BTC consolidation. Stoiiic cautiously expects one more squeeze (likely into 65–66K resistance zone per group consensus) to trap leveraged/weak positioning before a pullback/correction. Aligns with broader group theme: 60–65K range is key consolidation zone with multiple technical tests expected before directional confirmation.
